paymentModelHints.fixed_milestone: One total contract price, split into scoped deliverables (e.g. 30% demo + floor → 25% electrical + plumbing → 30% walls + paint → 15% final install). Pay each งวด only when that specific scope is inspected and done. Best for renovations with clear stages.
paymentModelHints.time_materials: Bill by actual labor (daily or hourly rate) + actual materials (optional markup). Operator logs each day's hours/cost; payments are batched from approved entries. Use when scope is too entangled to pre-define, or for ongoing repairs / punch-list work.
